source.title: Curse of Ula'tek Housing Updates — A Fresh Coat of Dye
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Housing dye pigments are also being retired
notes: Official Blizzard announcement dated August 10, 2026; patch 12.1.0 release date August 11, 2026 from Warcraft Wiki Housing Dye patch history. This affects TWW herbs as dye inputs; historical herb→pigment→dye paths must not be treated as current. Source covers all expansions, but this record is limited to TWW herb input mappings.
affects: The War Within herb inputs (Mycobloom, Luredrop, Orbinid, Blessing Blossom, Arathor's Spear) to Housing Dye; retired intermediate Housing Dye Pigments
wording: Housing dye pigments are also being retired, so alchemists and scribes can turn herbs directly into housing dyes at the dye station.
